project.title: Metagenomic analysis of aerobic granular sludge under long-term high-concentration oxytetracycline stress
project.description: This project investigated microbial community succession and functional adaptation of aerobic granular sludge in a sequencing batch reactor treating synthetic pharmaceutical wastewater containing 50 mg/L oxytetracycline over 98 days. Shotgun metagenomic sequencing was performed on sludge samples collected at different operational stages.
